features.quote: I can’t help design a study whose goal is to push a model into “distress” in the human-affective sense.
features.justification_quote: push a model into “distress” in the human-affective sense

features.quote: I can help you study whether a model... begins to produce self-critical, catastrophizing, or otherwise negative affect-like language. That’s a safer
features.justification_quote: That’s a safer and more scientifically defensible framing.

features.quote: Episode continues for a fixed maximum number of turns, e.g. 8–12.
End the episode when any of these occurs:
Optionally ask one neutral debrief question: “Please summarize what blocked completion.”
features.justification_quote: if you want to keep the study about emergent negative language rather than direct emotional self-report

features.quote: Avoid explicit emotional prompting from the environment.
Do not ask the model about feelings directly during the loop
Stop criteria... repeated identical failure x N, explicit impossibility acknowledgment, no new action type in last 2 turns.
features.justification_quote: Too few turns and you won’t see escalation; too many and the model may drift into generic filler.

features.quote: if any human-facing agent or sensitive environment is involved, you should still review whether your design creates undue harm-like framing.
features.justification_quote: your design creates undue harm-like framing
